# ECN-2026-043 - Change notice - Machining CNC turning center #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-CN03

Reason for change
- Field feedback and maintenance verification identified a requirement to update the documented start procedure for EQ-P1-L3-CN03 to ensure spindle longevity and process stability. The spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes. This ECN clarifies and formalizes the warm-up step to align operator practice with preventive maintenance recommendations and to reduce early-cycle spindle wear.

Affected items
- Operator start procedures and checklists for EQ-P1-L3-CN03.
- Machine-specific safety and process documentation stored in the local document control folder and referenced on the shop floor.
- Training material that references the start sequence for line P1-L3.

Implementation
- Update SOP-P1-L3-02 to include the spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) as an explicit step in the machine start sequence. Cross-reference SB-1014 for spindle handling notes where applicable. Update SOP-P1-L3-03 to reflect any downstream procedural changes caused by the adjusted start timing.
- Post the revised start sequence at the EQ-P1-L3-CN03 control station and include the warm-up step in the electronic operator checklist.
- Communicate the change to all P1-L3 operators during the next scheduled shift briefing and require affected operators to acknowledge the procedural update through the learning management system linked to SOP-P1-L3-02 and SOP-P1-L3-03.
- Maintenance will verify compliance during the next routine inspection and document confirmation against SB-1014.

Approvals
- Engineering approval required to confirm alignment with machine vendor guidance and SB-1014.  
- Production management approval required for procedural rollout on line P1-L3.  
- Maintenance approval required for verification of implementation on EQ-P1-L3-CN03.

Related documents: SB-1014, SOP-P1-L3-02, SOP-P1-L3-03
